evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes then I will be able to build you an accurate code you can depend on is now a good time?
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: you're moving from a fifteen by ten storage unit located in 1800 south loop 121 Belton, Texas... moving to a one bedroom apartment located in 2601, West Seventh Street, Fort Worth Texas... completely full
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised one concern (third-party vehicle loading), rep addressed it directly but did not probe deeper with follow-up questions like 'tell me more about that' or explore underlying worry.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection of the customer's stated concern. Rep moved to probing without confirming understanding.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (storage unit to apartment), floor/stories (second floor storage, first floor apt), walking distances (20 feet to elevator, ~40 feet elevator to unit, 100 feet to apartment door), fullness (completely full), heavy items (mattress, small sofa, nothing over 400 lbs), appliances (none), valuables (none).
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Now for a typical fifteen by ten storage unit, it usually takes around six to eight hours... we think it's reasonable to budget around $3,422 to $3,614, which includes the travel fee and overnight fee.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full transparency: $192/hour for two movers and one truck (all-inclusive: fuel, insurance, pads, tools), $240 overnight fee, $974 travel fee, no hidden fees, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments after minimum.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or paused for customer reaction to the price range.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: if we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange. We immediately start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: we have no worries, damage coverage we provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar; moved directly to ask for the business without confirming the Two Promises satisfied concerns.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: do you have any questions or anything for me? — generic throwaway question without genuine concern probing.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Would you like our help with your move? — Customer replied with 'Do you mind emailing me a quote?' rep accepted the out and did not re-ask or counter.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Confirmed: email (kia.campbell@gmail.com), earliest pickup time (8:30 AM), phone/availability (8 AM–5:30 PM daily). Missing: move date confirmation, arrival window for pickup day, crew size confirmation, destination address confirmation, notes left for crew about stored concerns.

top_strength: Nicole gathered comprehensive logistics details systematically (storage unit dimensions, floors, walking distances, fullness, contents) and delivered full, transparent pricing framing with all fees and rate structure upfront.
coaching_note: After the customer's initial concern, probe deeper with follow-up questions ('tell me more about that') instead of pivoting; when pricing is stated, pause and ask 'Does that feel fair?' before moving on; when the customer asks for an email, re-ask the explicit ask rather than accepting the easy out.
booking_note: Customer requested to receive the quote via email to discuss with family: 'Do you mind emailing me a quote? So I just, so I could talk to my family about it if you don't mind.'
